transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?
No matter how much I rest, I feel completely drained and can’t keep up or focus at work anymore. I've been trying to just push through it, but I'm completely exhausted all the time.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in activities you used to enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with friends?

Yes, completely. I used to love jogging, playing basketball, and working on Raspberry Pi projects, but now I just stare at my half-finished board and scroll on my phone. I've also stopped seeing my friends because I'm just too exhausted and don't have the interest anymore.
Have you had a period of depression before this one, and if so, how long did it last?
No, I’ve never experienced a period of depression before this. This is the first time I’ve ever felt this way, and it has been completely overwhelming.
Have you been feeling down, sad, or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day, since this started?

Yes, I have. Most days I wake up with this heavy, sinking feeling like a dark cloud is sitting on my chest, and I feel hopeless even on my days off for no real reason. This constant low mood has been going on for roughly the past year and a bit now.
Have you been feeling excessively guilty, even about small things, during this time?

Yes, I constantly feel like a terrible nurse's aide and just a bad person overall. I keep thinking that every small charting error or forgotten vital sign is proof that I'm putting patients at risk on purpose, and that I deserve to lose my job and be punished.
